title: Compose verify block
description: The optional `verify` block of `.compose/compose.json`. Two independent keys, neither required: `preflight` (COMP-SETUP-PREFLIGHT-1, lib/preflight.js) declares cheap setup checks and the run lock; `flows` (COMP-VERIFY-FLOW-1, lib/verify-flows.js) declares user flows that a completion must pass. A flow PASSes when it exits 0 AND every `expect` line appears in its stdout (lib/verify-flows.js judgeRun). No `flows` key means no flow ever runs; no `preflight` key means only the built-in Stratum engine check runs. Unknown keys are refused.

preflight.description: Cheap checks run before an expensive verification (the pre-push test gate, `compose build`, `compose preflight`). A failure is reported SETUP-FAIL, never as a product red. The built-in Stratum engine check runs with or without this block; this block only adds project checks and the run lock.

exclusive_runs.description: Hold a per-repository run lock (<main checkout>/.compose/data/verify-run.lock) for the whole gated run, so a second verification run on the same repository refuses SETUP-BUSY instead of racing the first. A holder whose pid is dead is a stale lock and is taken over. Default false.

busy_wait_s.description: Seconds a run waits for a live holder before refusing SETUP-BUSY. Default 0 (refuse at once).

id.description: Unique within the block. Names the check in output and in `failureReason: setup:<id>`. `stratum-engine` is reserved for the built-in check.

command.description: argv array, run with the project root as cwd. Never a shell string.

expect.description: Substring that must appear in the command's stdout or stderr. Without it, the check passes on exit 0.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the check is killed and fails. Default 10.

id.description: Unique within the block. Names the flow in output, logs and refusal codes.

command.description: argv array, run with the workspace root as cwd, in its own process group (same shape as guard.testCommand). Never a shell string.

covers.description: Repo-relative path globs (`*` one segment, `**` any depth, `?` one character). A completion whose changed files match any glob runs this flow. A leading `./` or `/` is dropped; a path with no glob character covers itself and everything under it (`src/x` = `src/x` and `src/x/**`). A `..` segment, a backslash, or a pattern that names nothing is refused at load. A flow matching no tracked file prints one WARNING.

expect.description: Literal lines that must each appear in stdout as a whole line (compared after trimming surrounding whitespace). They are the answer; the exit code alone never passes a flow.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the flow's whole process group is killed and the run refused FLOW_TIMEOUT. Default 600.

setup_exit_codes.description: Exit codes meaning the flow could not start (a missing tool, a port it could not get), reported FLOW_SETUP_ERROR rather than FLOW_FAILED. Default [127]. A spawn error (command not found) is always a setup error.
